scripts.build: turbo run build && npm run performance:budget
scripts.lint: eslint convex scripts && turbo run lint
scripts.lint:fix: eslint convex scripts --fix && turbo run lint:fix
scripts.test: turbo run test && npm run test:convex && npm run test:backup && npm run test:ci
scripts.test:convex: vitest run convex --config vitest.config.ts --configLoader runner --environment edge-runtime
scripts.test:security: vitest run convex/security.integration.test.ts packages/providers/src/providerSecurity.test.ts packages/providers/src/emailProvider.contract.test.ts --config vitest.config.ts --configLoader runner --environment edge-runtime
scripts.test:backup: vitest run scripts/backup --config vitest.config.ts --configLoader runner --environment node
scripts.test:ci: vitest run scripts/ci --config vitest.config.ts --configLoader runner --environment node
scripts.validate:environment: node scripts/ci/validate-environment.mjs --environment staging --source template --file .env.staging.example && node scripts/ci/validate-environment.mjs --environment production --source template --file .env.production.example
